text: A Glitch in the World
Wanjirou
Yo... It's incredible how much times have changed, woof. I think I'm starting to like this thing.
player
Yeah, though coming out of it has made me a little dizzy...
Yui Yagi
Post-VR sickness. Here, have some water.
Ichihime
That was a blast, nyaa! I wanna play "Oath of the Swordfish" again next time, nyaa!
...It's "A Lost Paradise: Oath of the Sword." It's the VR version of the long-running MMORPG "A Lost Paradise."
Natsuki Shinomiya
Hehe... Ahahaha! How truly immaculate a sensation to freely wield my beloved Luminas...
Not everyone's back to reality yet...
Didn't you just get sent flying though, nyaa?
When all's said and done, it's just mahjong in a VRMMO. What's the point of using swords...?
Ah... senpai. I need to stop by the grocery store to buy curry for tonight.
Is it already that late...? The sun's about to set, woof.
Then I should also... Nyaa?! Nyaa, nyaa?!
What is it...?
You didn't forget something, did you?
I left the rest of my snacks in the VR experience center, nyaa! I have to go back and get them!
I see. I'll go with you.
See you tomorrow then, woof. I'm off to get some ramen. Let's play VR mahjong again next time!
See you, senpai.
Is something wrong?
I took off the VR headset, didn't I? So why am I seeing an interface in front of me, nyaa? Poke, poke.
I told you, nyaa! The main menu, the inventory... it's all right there, nyaa! You're seeing it too, right, Master?
Kaguyahime
Ohoho... It's been a while, hasn't it, you two?
Ahh, it's that stupid rabbit, nyaa!
Huh?
I thought you usually go, "Uhehe"...
What are you doing here, Kaguyahime?
It doesn't matter how she laughs, that bad rabbit is rotten to her core, nyaa!
Whatever that bad rabbit's doing here, it can't be anything good, nyaa!
Did I just hear you're going back to Mahjong Soul Shrine? What a pity, because the shrine... belongs to me now!
You bad rabbit... did you hit your head or something, nyaa? We'd never let you take Mahjong Soul Shrine, nyaa!
Ohoho... Is that so? And what difference does that make?
Monsters
ROOOAAAR!!!
Nyaa?!! Where did those monsters come from?! Have you lost your mind, bad rabbit?!
Ohoho! I finally realized that if you want something, you must take it by force! I've already used my newly acquired power to utterly conquer Mahjong Soul Shrine!
If you bow down and swear fealty to me now, I just might spare your lives!
You can forget it, stupid rabbit! Send those monsters back where they came from, now nyaa!
You've gone too far this time, Kaguyahime!
Has she finally turned to the dark side?!
Since it appears you two won't surrender... then I'll just let my minions pulverize you!
ROOOAAAR!!!
Nyaa?! That bad rabbit's serious about this!!
Watch out, Ichihime! Run, this way!
Ohoho! Struggling is useless! It isn't just Mahjong Soul Shrine, all of One Han City is under my control now... Where do you think you can run, hmm?
After them!
Hahh... hahh... Why is this happening, nyaa?!
Is this some sort of nightmare?!
Is there anyone who can come help us?!
That's right, nyaa! There must be someone who can deal with this freak situation! Somebody, anybody! Come save us!
If they're an expert at slaying scary monsters, even better, nyaa...!!!
Surely now isn't the time for wishful thinking?!
It's no use, nyaa! I haven't even gotten my snacks back, it can't end like this, nyaa!
Forget about the snacks, worry about yourself first! Dang it... There are monsters here, too!
ROOOAAAR!!!
Nyaaow?! We're done for, nyaa!!
Ichihime... look out!!
(Shield Ichihime with your body!)
Guhhk...!!!
Master! Are you okay, nyaa?!
That was amazing... You defeated the monsters in just one blow...?! Who are you...?
Yo! You're not hurt, are you? I couldn't just stand there and watch you get attacked by monsters.
Kirito
I'm Kirito, nice to meet you! That reminds me – what is this place?
Okay, Master, let's hurry back and get my snacks, nyaa...!
Huh? What's this, nyaa?
That's impossible... Are you getting post-VR sickness too?
Huh? Wait, I'm seeing it too?!
Did you see that, {var:player_nickname}? This is the consummate power of White Night!
Well, {var:player_nickname}... I look forward to the next time fate brings us together! Until then!
